_comment: Per-event time overrides applied at the end of scripts/updateSchedule.ts. Use when a league reschedules a game but our upstream source (ESPN, etc.) hasn't caught up yet. Match by event id; set startTimeLocal (and optionally endTimeLocal) in ISO UTC. Remove an entry once upstream is correct so the manual edit doesn't drift.

events.reason: MLS rescheduled SJ @ LAFC to 1:00 PM PT kickoff; ESPN scoreboard still shows 4:00 PM PT as of 2026-04-19.
